We’re excited to get the renewal QBR and roadmap demo scheduled — the account execs want a short executive segment, followed by a hands-on roadmap walkthrough. Unfortunately the current slot (Oct 1, 10am PT) conflicts with our leadership offsite.

Can you do a staggered approach where:
- Exec-only segment (30 min) for our C-suite
- Followed by a technical walkthrough (60 min) for platform and engineering teams

Two windows that work for us:
- Option A: Oct 4, 8:30–10:00 PT (exec 8:30–9:00)
- Option B: Oct 6, 13:00–14:30 PT (exec 13:00–13:30)

Also important for us: who will have access to the recording, and can we restrict download to named attendees? We have a few external partners joining and need an access matrix.

Attached our internal attendee list (redacted) — happy to share more if helpful.

Thanks,

Hi Claire — thanks for the heads up and the clear options. Staggered sessions are exactly the kind of format that works well for renewal QBRs. Quick answers up front: we can do both windows, we support a recorded exec segment with access controls, and we’ll surface a simple access matrix for named viewers.

Proposed plan:
- Hold the exec-only 30m + tech 60m immediately after (staggered back-to-back) to reduce meeting churn for your team.
- If you pick Option A or B, we’ll prepare two meeting invites (one for execs with "view-only" recording permission, one for the technical session with broader access).
- We will produce an "access_matrix.xlsx" listing who can view/download the recording plus suggested retention (we typically propose 90 days for recordings tied to renewals).

I’m attaching a draft agenda (QBR_agenda_v2.pdf) and the access_matrix.xlsx draft for your review.

Questions for you:
1) Which option do you prefer (A: Oct 4 morning PT or B: Oct 6 early afternoon PT)?
2) Any external partner emails we should pre-authorize for recording access?
3) Do you want the exec recording to be restricted to named attendees (no link share) or link share with tokenized access?

Marissa (CS) — can you own the meeting invites and recording retention notes? Ben — want to join the exec segment?

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber

Claire
